source_document: Road Safety Authority, Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), September 2026 (21 pages)
source_note: General driver-education guide with EU/IE regulatory context (incl. GSR2). Generic knowledge only: not a manufacturer equipment catalog and not vehicle-specific proof. Page numbers below are physical PDF pages; printed footers read one lower (e.g. PDF p. 13 == 'Page 12 of 21'). Definitions are concise paraphrases, not quotations; no illustrations are reproduced.
market_scope: European Union / Ireland driver guidance; generic across manufacturers

entries.definition: Maintains a driver-selected speed via throttle (and sometimes engine braking/brakes on descents); does not react to traffic ahead.

symbols.description: Speedometer dial with needle and set-arrow; alternatively a CRUISE/SET dashboard text telltale.
symbols.location_hint: instrument cluster telltale; set speed shown on cluster or screen
symbols.limitation: Telltale artwork varies by manufacturer; text vs icon forms both occur.

entries.visual_support: A speedometer-only or CRUISE/SET telltale, or ON/SET/RES buttons with no distance function, supports conventional cruise at most.
entries.cannot_prove: Never proves adaptive cruise control, gap-keeping, or stop-and-go capability.
entries.limitations: Generic description; some systems also brake on descents.

entries.definition: Cruise control that additionally uses radar or cameras to detect vehicles ahead and adjusts speed to maintain a driver-selected following gap; some systems stop and restart in traffic.

symbols.description: Speedometer dial with a car silhouette above it and a set-arrow; alternatively an icon showing a car with distance bars.
symbols.location_hint: instrument cluster; set speed and sometimes following distance displayed nearby
symbols.limitation: Artwork varies; distance-bars motif is the ACC-specific cue, not the speedometer alone.

entries.visual_support: A dedicated following-distance control, or a car-with-distance-bars indicator, is meaningful visual support subject to correct identification and vehicle applicability.
entries.cannot_prove: A speedometer-only or generic cruise control does not prove ACC. A following-distance control does not automatically establish Stop & Go.
entries.limitations: Stop/restart ability differs between implementations; guide does not enumerate which.

entries.definition: ACC variant able to bring the vehicle to a stop in traffic and resume motion; a subset of ACC implementations.
entries.visual_support: No distinct symbol is documented in the guide; do not infer from a following-distance control alone.
entries.cannot_prove: A following-distance control or ACC indicator does not establish low-speed stopping/resumption behavior.
entries.limitations: Guide mentions the capability in one sentence; no identification criteria given.

entries.definition: Warns (visual, audible, or vibration) when the vehicle drifts out of its lane without indicating; does not intervene.

symbols.description: Tilted car crossing dashed lane lines.
symbols.limitation: Illustrative; exact glyph varies by manufacturer.

entries.visual_support: A car-crossing-lane-lines motif supports a warning-only interpretation, not steering intervention.
entries.cannot_prove: Never proves corrective steering, continuous centering, or hands-free capability.
entries.limitations: Requires visible lane markings; guide stresses degraded performance on poor roads/weather.

entries.definition: Provides light steering input (or braking adjustment) to help keep the vehicle in lane when approaching or crossing a line without indicating.

symbols.description: Front-view car positioned between dashed lane lines.
symbols.location_hint: instrument cluster; related controls may sit on wheel, stalk, or left dashboard depending on manufacturer
symbols.limitation: Same car-between-lanes motif is reused across lane-assistance meanings; manufacturer documentation decides.

entries.visual_support: A documented dedicated LKA control (button or cluster indicator) is meaningful support subject to vehicle applicability.
entries.cannot_prove: Never automatically establishes continuous centering, highway assistance, or hands-free driving.
entries.limitations: Intervention style (steering vs braking) varies; guide does not enumerate per-manufacturer behavior.

entries.definition: Continuously steers to keep the vehicle at or near lane centre (RSA 'Active systems' tier), especially on motorways; distinct from warning (LDW) and corrective keeping (LKA).

symbols.description: No standalone centering glyph is documented; the guide illustrates supervision via the hands-on-steering-wheel alert (wheel with hands plus text).
symbols.limitation: Absence of a dedicated icon means centering must be established through manufacturer documentation, not generic symbols.

entries.visual_support: A general lane icon or LKA control does not establish centering; only manufacturer-documented centering evidence counts.
entries.cannot_prove: Never proves hands-free driving; never inferred from LKA/LDW icons alone.
entries.limitations: Guide discusses continuous centering within wider lane-assistance text; terminology normalized here to the distinct capability.

entries.definition: Simultaneous use of lane centering assistance and adaptive cruise control as one supervised support feature; the driver must constantly supervise and retains responsibility.
entries.visual_support: Requires evidence of both longitudinal and lateral components; one component alone never establishes the combination.
entries.cannot_prove: Never proves hands-free driving; supervision requirement is part of the definition.
entries.limitations: Marketing names for combined systems vary widely and are not enumerated here.

entries.definition: Monitors the road ahead with radar/cameras and alerts the driver (visual, audible, vibration) to a potential collision with a vehicle, pedestrian, or object; does not brake.

symbols.description: Two cars (or a car with a starburst/arrow motif); warning state may flash lights, sounds, or seat vibration.
symbols.limitation: Alert iconography overlaps with general warning symbols; context matters.

entries.visual_support: A two-cars or collision-alert telltale supports warning capability only.
entries.cannot_prove: Never proves automatic braking; detection hardware or a generic warning icon does not establish AEB.
entries.limitations: May miss obstacles in poor weather or with blocked/dirty sensors.

entries.definition: Detects an imminent frontal collision and automatically applies the brakes when the driver does not respond, avoiding or mitigating impact.

symbols.limitation: Telltale confirms the warning/display side, not that auto-braking hardware is fitted.

entries.visual_support: A warning telltale alone supports FCW at most; AEB needs manufacturer documentation of auto-brake fitment.
entries.cannot_prove: A warning icon or visible sensor housing does not prove automatic braking will occur.
entries.limitations: Forward systems only; reverse and cross-traffic variants are separate capabilities.

entries.definition: Detects vehicles (and some systems VRUs/objects) approaching from the side at the rear while reversing and warns the driver.
entries.visual_support: Side/rear mirror or cluster warning indicators support warning capability only.
entries.limitations: Guide treats rear cross-traffic alert as an advanced BSM/BSIS level.

entries.definition: Automatically brakes while in reverse to avoid or mitigate a detected rear collision.
entries.visual_support: Warning indicators alone do not establish auto-braking; needs documented fitment.
entries.cannot_prove: A reversing camera or parking sensors do not prove automatic rear braking.
entries.limitations: One-line treatment in the guide; identification criteria minimal.

entries.definition: Reads speed limits (camera sign recognition plus GPS/map data) and responds when exceeded, at advisory (information), supportive (warning), or intervening (active speed limiting, overridable) levels.

symbols.description: Current speed-limit roundel (e.g. circled '70') shown on cluster or infotainment; exceedance adds flashing symbols, sounds, or pedal feedback.
symbols.limitation: Sign-recognition display confirms the display function, not which ISA level is fitted.

entries.visual_support: A displayed speed limit supports sign-recognition display; active limiting needs documented evidence.
entries.cannot_prove: A speed-limit display does not prove intervening (active-control) ISA.
entries.limitations: May misread temporary or unclear signs; level must be established per vehicle.

entries.definition: Displays the area behind the vehicle (often with guidelines) when reverse gear is engaged.
entries.visual_support: A rear camera view supports a camera display only.
entries.cannot_prove: A backup camera never proves automated parking functionality.
entries.limitations: Display aid only; no steering or braking authority implied.

entries.definition: Ultrasonic sensors detect nearby obstacles during parking and give audio/visual warnings with increasing frequency as distance closes.
entries.visual_support: Sensor graphics or beep patterns support warning-only proximity sensing.
entries.cannot_prove: Sensors alone never prove steering or braking automation.
entries.limitations: May miss very small, low, or moving objects; dirty sensors degrade performance.

entries.definition: Steers into a parking space while the driver controls speed, braking, and gear selection; driver supervises throughout.

symbols.description: On-screen messages indicating the park-assist mode is active (semi vs full distinguished by stated driver responsibilities, not by icon alone).
symbols.limitation: Guide pairs semi and full modes under one caption; the icon alone does not resolve the level.

entries.visual_support: An explicit semi-automatic mode message supports supervised steering automation with driver-controlled speed/braking.
entries.cannot_prove: Camera views or sensor graphics alone never prove automated steering.
entries.limitations: Driver-responsibility split must be established; icons alone are ambiguous.

entries.definition: Controls steering, acceleration, braking, and gear changes to park with minimal driver input (including driver-outside remote variants); driver still supervises.

symbols.description: Same park-assist mode messaging family as semi-automatic; level resolved by stated responsibilities, not iconography.
symbols.limitation: See semi-automatic limitation; remote operation needs explicit evidence.

entries.visual_support: Only an explicit full-automation or remote-parking mode indication counts, subject to documentation.
entries.cannot_prove: Never inferred from cameras, sensors, or semi-automatic indications.
entries.limitations: Rare fitment; default assumption must be the lower automation level.

entries.definition: Detects vehicles (and some systems VRUs) in blind spots and warns, usually via a mirror or cluster light; advanced systems may add steering/braking assist, and rear cross-traffic alert is an advanced level.

symbols.description: Two cars with radiating waves (monitoring motif); active state shows a light in the door mirror or cluster.
symbols.limitation: Warn vs active-assist levels share indicator families; intervention needs documentation.

entries.visual_support: A mirror/cluster blind-spot light supports warning capability; steering/braking assist needs documented evidence.
entries.cannot_prove: A warning light never proves active steering or braking intervention.
entries.limitations: May miss fast vehicles, small objects, or motorcycles; dirt/weather degrade sensors.

entries.definition: Estimates drowsiness or distraction from driving patterns (and some systems eye/head tracking) and issues take-a-break warnings; may lack a continuous active indicator.

symbols.description: Coffee cup with steam (driver-status motif); some systems show cluster symbols only when warning.
symbols.limitation: Absence of an indicator does not mean the system is absent; it may warn only.

entries.visual_support: A coffee-cup or take-a-break message supports the warning function when active.
entries.cannot_prove: Absence of a telltale proves nothing; driver-monitoring capability is not established from generic cluster icons.
entries.limitations: Indirect systems infer from behavior and miss cases; direct (camera) vs indirect types differ.

entries.definition: Monitors per-tyre air pressure and warns (light or message, sometimes per-tyre readings) when pressure falls below recommended levels.

symbols.description: Horseshoe/tyre cross-section with an exclamation mark (tyre-pressure warning).
symbols.limitation: Warning absence does not mean pressures were recently checked.

entries.visual_support: The horseshoe-exclamation telltale or per-tyre pressure display supports TPMS fitment.
entries.cannot_prove: Does not establish any other ADAS capability; out of scope for audit claims but useful as a negative control.
entries.limitations: Informational for the audit pipeline; included for symbol-reference completeness.
